### Screenshots

Refreshes the SwiftBar captures on [the plugin's page](https://mpm.run/bar-plugin/).

Each one is a real screenshot: a hosted runner installs SwiftBar and Xbar from their pinned releases, hands each the plugin file itself, and plants a stand-in `mpm` serving the menu `BarPluginRenderer` produces from `docs/outdated-sample.json`. Each menu is opened with a real mouse event and photographed by window bounds, the *About* submenu is unfolded by resting the pointer on its row, and SwiftBar's preferences pane is reached through its own menu and scrolled with a real wheel event. Only the package data and the clocks are held still: the system clock is pinned to `10:30`, and the plugin's last run is aged five minutes so SwiftBar's *Updated N Minutes Ago* footer cannot rewrite every image on every run.

This PR is auto-generated by `.github/workflows/docs-screenshots.yaml`. Review it as a picture: anything unexpected in the frame is the finding.
